# Flex Order

::: info 实现进度 50% · 进行中
布局 / 字号 / 语义色 helper 已进 SDK。调色盘（gray/red/yellow/green/blue/cyan/indigo/purple/pink 50–900）已写入 `helpers-palette.css`。`hover:` / `focus:` / 全量 `m:` `pc:` 色盘仍缺，所以不能标已完成。
:::

不改 schema 顺序，只改视觉顺序。

```schema
type: page
body:
  - type: tpl
    className: flex gap-2
    tpl: '<span class="order-3 bg-muted p-sm rounded-md">A order-3</span><span class="order-1 bg-muted p-sm rounded-md">B order-1</span><span class="order-2 bg-muted p-sm rounded-md">C order-2</span>'
```

## 类名

| Class | Properties |
| --- | --- |
| `order-first` | `order: -9999` |
| `order-last` | `order: 9999` |
| `order-none` | `order: 0` |
| `order-1` | `order: 1` |
| `order-2` | `order: 2` |
| `order-3` | `order: 3` |

响应式：`m:` / `pc:` 已接到间距、宽高、display / flex、语义色。状态前缀见 [辅助类-状态样式](/style/state)。
